# Genuine distribution fixture

`voidra-skills-d5f6775.tgz` preserves public source from [Hussain7Abbas/voidra-skills at d5f677533d22b0fc0effa46166338f33ddfad68b](https://github.com/Hussain7Abbas/voidra-skills/tree/d5f677533d22b0fc0effa46166338f33ddfad68b), fetched 2026-10-14. It contains the unchanged validation/publication scripts, pinned package/lockfile, Makefile, catalog, skills, docs and instructions. Git metadata, installed dependencies and unrelated workflow files are excluded.

Tests unpack this snapshot into disposable repositories and use its genuine make validate/publish rules with local bare remotes. The archive is a fixture, not independently developed tooling or proof of a live GitHub publication. Existing skill attribution and license metadata are preserved.
